title: Write Integers to a Binary File
description: Write the function definition for writeIntegersToBinaryFile that takes an array of 5 integers and writes them to a binary file. The function should print the integers written to the binary file, each one on a separate line.
hints: Use fopen with 'wb' mode to open the binary file for writing.
Loop through the integers and use fwrite to write each integer to the file.
Print each integer to the console using printf before writing it to the file.
Ensure the file is closed properly using fclose after all integers are written.
